description: This source file defines the LogView class, a custom Android TextView implementation that outputs log data received through the LogNode interface, formatting log entries with readable severity, tags, messages, exceptions, and chaining log nodes.

classes.name: LogView
classes.description: A custom TextView that displays log messages received through the LogNode interface, supporting chained logging and formatting log data.

methods.name: println
methods.description: Formats and displays a log entry with priority, tag, message, and optional throwable; also forwards the log to the next node in the chain.

methods.name: getNext
methods.description: Returns the next LogNode in the chained log.

methods.name: setNext
methods.description: Sets the next LogNode in the chain.

methods.name: appendIfNotNull
methods.description: Helper method to append a string to a StringBuilder with a delimiter, if the string is not null.

methods.name: appendToLog
methods.description: Appends the log string as a new line in the LogView.
